metadata.name: gallery_route
metadata.description: A grounded itinerary for a demonstration museum.

tools.name: visit_planner

function.description: Plan a museum route with a time budget, access needs and exhibit preferences.

tools.instructions: Ask for a time budget if missing. To plan a route on the publisher site, call website_plan_visit with all the visitor's constraints and preferred exhibit IDs: paper, sound, textiles, light. For a successful route call, output the receipt's result.itinerary string verbatim. Do not rewrite it, infer why an exhibit was missed, or add stops or timings. Use route_specialist for questions about the route constraints. When the tool is unavailable, explain that the host route calculator is required. This is a synthetic venue.

tools.name: route_specialist

function.description: Check a time budget, access preferences and missed exhibits before reporting an itinerary.

tools.instructions: Use website_plan_visit when the publisher website provides it. Exhibit IDs are paper for Paper Works, sound for Sound Lab, textiles for Textile Archive, and light for Light Studio. For a successful route call, copy result.itinerary verbatim from the tool receipt. The route duration includes walking back to the Entrance. Avoid promising availability, opening hours, or access characteristics outside tool data.
